#ClothingShop #RetailIndia #BoutiqueOwner #ShopOwner #WholesaleClothing #ProfitMargin #SmallBusinessIndia #GarmentBazaar

One of the most common pricing mistakes in small clothing retail: confusing margin with markup.

Add 40% to your cost and your margin is not 40%. It is about 29%. Leave out freight, travel and packing, and the real number is lower still. Then come end-of-season discounts and the pieces that never sell.

For shop owners in Tier 2, 3 and 4 towns, getting this right is often the difference between a busy shop and a profitable one. Our new free guide walks through landed cost, margin vs markup, target margins by product type, and a five-minute check to run before every wholesale order.
